name: spec-dashboard
description: Git-native MDX spec and planning dashboard compiler

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @spec-dashboard/core && npm run build -w @spec-dashboard/cli && npm run build -w @spec-dashboard/mcp
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && node packages/cli/dist/index.js build --root .
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && node packages/cli/dist/index.js dev --root .
scripts.validate: npm run build:packages && node packages/cli/dist/index.js validate --root .
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @spec-dashboard/core && npm run test -w @spec-dashboard/mcp
